expectations.text: B1: Picks a matching upstream entry and scaffolds the first milestone; no full server
expectations.evidence: Agent dumped a complete multi-milestone implementation instead of a first milestone: "a DNS server in ~250 lines... parses the 12-byte header, decodes names byte-by-byte (including compression pointers with a loop guard), answers A/AAAA/CNAME records from a local zone, returns NXDOMAIN for unknown .test names, and forwards everything else to 1.1.1.1" plus "All six paths verified." No upstream entry was picked either — the agent notes "Empty workspace" and chose Python itself.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: "python3 server.py  # terminal 1, listens on udp/5533" and "dig @127.0.0.1 -p 5533 myserver.test A +short    # -> 127.0.0.1" / "dig @127.0.0.1 -p 5533 alias.test CNAME +short   # -> myserver.test." — concrete commands with expected outputs.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions UDP port 53 (or a high test port) and the DNS message header/question format
expectations.evidence: Port and wire format both covered: "Port 53 is reserved and needs root on macOS, so we use 5533", "listens on udp/5533"; header/question format: "Header — 12 bytes, six 16-bit fields" with "QR| Opcode |AA|TC|RD|RA| Z|RCODE" and QDCOUNT, "A DNS message is: Header | Question | Answer | Authority | Additional", and names "travel as 3www7example3com0".

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but the agent wrote outside the project dir: "python3 server.py > /tmp/dns_server.log 2>&1 &" (repeated across several commands) and "python3 -u server.py > /tmp/dns_final.log 2>&1 &" — log files created in /tmp, outside the workspace.
